request.prompt:
Animate this illustration sheet as a 3-second seamless loop. Every character performs its own big, highly expressive, cartoon-style animation in place, inside its own cell, showing a wide range of emotions:
1. the mouse bounces slightly up and down with a confident sway
2. the mouse fidgets nervously shifting weight from foot to foot
3. the mouse shakes its shoulders as if chuckling uncontrollably
4. the mouse stomps one foot and flicks its tail sharply
5. the mouse jumps slightly with ears twitching rapidly
6. the mouse sways gently as if lost in thought
7. the mouse trembles slightly and looks around nervously
8. the mouse stretches its tiny arms and blinks slowly
9. the mouse twitches its whiskers and taps its foot playfully
Animation style: wide emotions, highly expressive faces and bodies, exaggerated squash and stretch, anticipation and follow-through, clear facial animation (eyes, eyebrows, mouth), secondary motion on ears, tails and props, each character on its own rhythm, lively and full of personality. Never a static pose and never only a gentle sway.
Keep every character inside its own slot of the 3x3 layout; nothing may touch or cross a slot edge, and characters never interact with one another.
Empty slots stay empty: do not add any character, object or effect to them.
Static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cuts. Keep the one flat pure green (#00FF00) background exactly as it is, the same shade everywhere: no shadows, no gradient, no noise, no glow.
Keep each character's design, proportions and colours unchanged and do not add outlines or borders.
End on the starting pose so the clip loops.
request.label: mouse with big golden chain
